_comment: Notification + calendar config. Recipients = ONE team channel; internal calendar = ONE shared calendar. Fill the *_id fields once, resolved via the connectors.

calendar._provider_note: Google Calendar is wired. Teams/Outlook needs a Microsoft Graph connector added before provider can be 'microsoft'.

boundary: Internal team channel and the shared internal calendar are authorised internal reminders and may auto-create/post. Client-facing calendar invites and any message to a client or counterparty stay draft-only: they require per-item approval and only ever fire from a VERIFIED row.
